atAGlance: A gentler cousin of beef phở, with clear chicken broth, rice noodles, herbs, lime, and tender slices or shreds of gà.
whatItIs: Phở gà is chicken noodle soup built on a clean, fragrant broth rather than the deeper beef bones of phở bò. Expect flat rice noodles, chicken, onion, scallion, herbs, and lime or chili on the side.
howToEnjoy: Taste the broth before adding anything. Then use lime, herbs, and chili in small steps so you can notice the sweetness of the chicken broth.
howLocalsOrder: Order Phở gà when you want the cleaner chicken version of phở. Taste the broth before lime or chili, then add herbs gently so the chicken sweetness still comes through.
worthKnowing: Phở gà is a comforting breakfast or light dinner, and in Hanoi especially it can be beautifully spare: broth, noodles, chicken, and herbs with no need for theatrics.
goodToKnow: Ask for không cay if you do not want chili sauce added.
